diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS, germinal-center B-cell (GCB) phenotype by the Hans algorithm (CD10+, BCL6+, MUM1-), as signed out on 2026-09-12 and as recorded on the problem list.
stage: Lugano (Ann Arbor) stage II bulky (IIA-X): FDG-avid right cervical nodes and a 12.0 cm anterior mediastinal mass, all above the diaphragm. No B symptoms. No extranodal, splenic, osseous, marrow, testicular or CNS involvement on PET-CT. A 12 cm mass is bulky, so this is managed as advanced-stage disease rather than limited-stage disease.
biology: Double-expressor by IHC (MYC 80%, BCL2 90%), Ki-67 95%. The FISH addendum reports MYC and BCL2 rearrangements; BCL6 not rearranged. High-risk biology, but treat per the existing DLBCL plan.
prognosis: IPI 1 (only LDH elevated); high-risk biology by IHC.
first_line_treatment: Proceed with R-CHOP every 21 days for 6 cycles, cycle 1 on 2026-09-22 as planned; the port is already in place. Consolidative involved-site radiotherapy to the bulky mediastinal mass if residual disease.
cns_risk: CNS-IPI 1. Given high-risk biology, contrast MRI brain and lumbar puncture with CSF cytology and flow cytometry before cycle 1; consider intrathecal methotrexate as CNS prophylaxis.
response_assessment: End-of-treatment FDG PET-CT read with Lugano 2014 criteria and the Deauville 5-point scale.
pretreatment_workup: HBsAg and anti-HBc nonreactive. Echo LVEF 60%, anthracycline permitted.
supportive_care: Tumor lysis syndrome risk intermediate: allopurinol and hydration with TLS labs. G-CSF (pegfilgrastim) with each cycle. Use the port. Offer sperm banking. Monitor for SVC symptoms and airway compromise.
fitness_and_goals: Fit for full-dose curative R-CHOP: age 54, ECOG 1, LVEF 60%.
